# Loop Discipline

This is a fixture file for testing render-universal-skills.ts.

## Slice ceremony

You MUST open every slice via the start ceremony.
You MUST close every slice via the complete ceremony.
Iron Law: never skip the slice close ceremony.

## Handoff rules

You cannot exit without writing the handoff artifact.
You must always include the slice id in the handoff title.

## Auto-continue

The loop MUST auto-continue after ceremony.
never stop for confirmation unless externally blocked.
